findings_and_related_questions.classification: Existing conditional window frame/aggregate question, independently connected to current SceneWindow decoder; no new accepted count.
findings_and_related_questions.trace: SceneWindow decoder re-admits size, centre, tangent and outward separately; SpatialDirection checks each vector independently for normalized direction. The component decoder does not separately check the pair for perpendicularity or relation to an opening/hinge. A symbolic wire with two individually normalized parallel directions illustrates the local missing relationship, but no wire was constructed or decoded. Normal server spawn derives both from one SceneWindowPose built from the selected compiled opening and datum.
findings_and_related_questions.conditions: A supported decoder or other public construction must admit a mismatched frame, and the chosen opening policy must require that relationship. The actual server private controller/pose route, plan membership, consumers and any resulting interaction error remain separate. The existing previous P16 walls/windows record traces earlier OpeningAssembly and WindowSpec; same exact defect/repair alias must be reconciled centrally.
findings_and_related_questions.historical_relationship: 774 NATIVE-INITIAL05-GROUP-124 and CAMERA-INITIAL07-CONTRACT-248 already distinguish checked leaves from aggregate correctness; 059 READ-L11-458 preserves role2819 1–75 only. findings_and_related_questions.future_direction: If supported boundaries rely on an orthogonal frame, preserve source owner/hinge/pose and validate the whole relationship at the earliest applicable admission, preserving legitimate window leaf, bar and frame semantics.

findings_and_related_questions.classification: Existing historical motor/config/native scheduling evidence question, partially supplied by current source; no new accepted count.
findings_and_related_questions.trace: Current controller adapter clears Ahoy acceleration, air/water acceleration, friction and stop speed, then maps gravity, maximum step and cosine of walkable slope from one TacticalCombatConfig motor record. The current movement system calls the adapter in its per-controller loop. Config validation checks these fields finite and positive, limits step to at most 1 m and slope below 90 degrees; compiled default is validated before canonical use and the runtime snapshot installer validates before replacement.
findings_and_related_questions.conditions: Public configuration fields and independently populated Bevy resources mean these displayed entry paths do not prove every caller/resource was admitted; native Ahoy behavior, order across all producers and target configuration are uninspected. The disabling of native acceleration/friction is explicitly paired with tactical motor force policy, not itself a duplicated fatigue penalty.
findings_and_related_questions.historical_relationship: 774 CAMERA-INITIAL07-CONTRACT-181/191 and QUAL159 record the separate P16/pr-working source and actual bounded recovery qualification; 059 q1560 retains other quickstep, config and native dependencies. No native runtime/caller closure follows.
findings_and_related_questions.future_direction: Trace exact authorized configuration admission and all motor/native owners; retain a single supported horizontal integration authority without introducing hidden combat penalties.

findings_and_related_questions.classification: Current 95e source transition and unresolved native scheduling/behavior question; not asserted defect or unique count.
findings_and_related_questions.trace: Historical P16 and PR plugin source choose full simulation, presentation-only simulation or read-only collider mode; full simulation takes precedence when both booleans are true. Current presentation mode adds synchronous collider-tree optimization and runs Solver and Sleeping sets only if the query finds a non-static RigidBody without RigidBodyDisabled. The query includes all enabled non-static bodies, not specifically awake ragdolls. Read-only mode separately retains collider-tree finalization and required disabled components.
findings_and_related_questions.conditions: Whether required-component insertion, system-set nesting, collision tree updates, sleeping/waking and Bevy/Avian ordering satisfy every supported mode depends on exact native package semantics and real plugin installers. The current source tests express intended enabled/disabled ball behavior but were read only, not executed. No actual motion, missed query, performance effect or scheduler defect is claimed.
findings_and_related_questions.historical_relationship: 059 READ-L11-459 and 774 CAMERA-INITIAL07-CONTRACT-181/191 cover the separate old roles at the old bytes; the changed 95e branch is a fresh source observation, not transferred historical coverage. Preserve explicit full-simulation precedence and no false duplicate.
findings_and_related_questions.future_direction: If the policy requires complete assurance, trace native sets and component insertion plus all plugin mode installers, then validate supported motion and query behavior only after separate authorization.

nonfindings: SceneWindow uses a manual decoder to attach building/opening context to geometry errors; typed leaf validation does not establish complete descriptor/controller/plan correlation, but the decoder is not a mere redundant alias.
Two plugin flags yield three branches with explicit full-simulation precedence; the existence of both true is not alone an invalid behavior or compatibility shim.

The display of source tests is not their execution. Old native reviewers gave window PR role2819 1–75 only; separately attributed native P16 role366 full129 is distinct and does not enlarge that PR role.
Validated default and snapshot installer narrow ordinary configuration uncertainty; separate in-memory or externally inserted resource and native callers remain open.
Old/pr plugin source equality, a120 base-file equality, and same controller bytes are object facts only, not equal whole historical snapshots or resolved runtime behavior.

How should historical F002/F003 window/controller, frame aggregate, quickstep retention and current presentation scheduling map to distinct owners and duplicate counts?
